The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.

verses.text: the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,

xrefs.text: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
the God who avenges me and brings down nations beneath me,
He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.

verses.text: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.

xrefs.text: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life; they have no regard for You.

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when Saul sent men to watch David’s house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.

verses.text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.

xrefs.text: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to Your name.”
Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:
Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

verses.text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.

xrefs.text: to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
He will build a house for My Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob, of Israel His inheritance.
